abstract.p: Collecting and utilizing user data is essential for effective recommender systems to personalize content. However, privacy and compliance regulations protect personal user data. With strict regulations such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) in effect, one may ask: how can a recommender system be both compliant and effective? This paper aims to answer this question, demonstrating privacycompliant personalization for the Recommended Documents service within Microsoft 365 (M365), particularly Microsoft Feed. It outlines the development of an exemplary L-Profile personalization feature from conception to productionization, covering offline and online evaluations.
